note: T0 (adv-20261030-isolations-teaser-t0). Footage: Mohammad's upload of the official Japanese teaser (Kojima Productions / Disney+, 44 s, 1280x720, 0.44 Mbps; the only official copies are Kojima Productions' YouTube and X). Trailer-showcase layout (trailer rule 26 Oct, point 4: weak 720p source would need 2.7x to fill 9:16): the trailer at its own width, 1.5x, centred, over a blurred dimmed moving copy, pre-composited to 1080x1920 (dsi-framed.mp4 = source 6.0 to 31.2 s, the story stretch after the Disney+, Kojima Productions and E&H logo cards and before the title cards). One continuous stretch, its own sound (music and effects, no speech: faster-whisper found none). Disney+ bug stays in the picture (official mark).
